skill.summary: Organized research and knowledge management for agents. Use when you need to structure, store, retrieve, and export research notes across topics. Supports adding notes with tags, listing topics, searching across all notes, and exporting to markdown. Perfect for multi-session projects, tracking ideas, and maintaining structured knowledge.

latestVersion.changelog: Security fix: Added path validation to prevent malicious file writes. Export function now restricts output to safe directories (workspace, home, /tmp) and blocks system paths and sensitive dotfiles. Addresses vulnerability reported by VirusTotal scan.
